issues.on_page: Documentation of Transfers (p2): Sinking to General, 43,462.00, 'Capital outlay reimbursement'
issues.issue: Budget-form rule says transfers come from the Documentation of Transfers page (p2). The amount matches p2 and lines 16/28 on p1, but transfers_in/transfers_out cite page 1.

This unlabeled line is 45% of governmental receipts (205,202.09 of 453,271.69), and the year before it was 122,623.86. 'other' is defensible because the form gives no detail, but a sum this large at a fire district could be rural fire contracts, insurance proceeds or donations. It needs review.
